input.rejected_candidate_policy: unconditional hash denial in production and synthetic-test input paths

split.test_policy: labels unavailable to model selection, feature selection, hyperparameter selection, calibration-method selection, and threshold selection
split.ground_truth_isolation: answers and all other non-allowlisted top-level values are skipped without decoding into admission rows; train/calibration answers are selectively materialized for their assigned documents; test answers are first materialized after the exclusive STARTED marker

endpoints.em_error: 1 if Exact Match is false, else 0
endpoints.severity_only: 1 - ANLS; never a training endpoint in Phase A

features.question_types_provenance: dataset annotation copied from the validation Parquet row; unavailable without annotation at inference time; reporting only
features.token_count_provenance: number of token IDs in generated.sequences[0, input_length:]; excludes prompt token IDs but may include generated special-token IDs such as EOS because counting occurs before decoding with skip_special_tokens=True; tokenized by the frozen Qwen3-VL AutoProcessor tokenizer

selection.calibration_method_selection: true nested document-group CV: inner GroupKFold creates calibrator-training OOF predictions inside each outer-train; outer-validation labels are used only for final candidate-pair Brier scoring
selection.fold_class_policy: fail the entire nested selection before candidate scoring if any outer-train or inner-train fit partition lacks either class; single-class outer-validation is allowed because Brier is defined
selection.selection_metric: Brier score with deterministic lexical tie-breaking

calibration.scope: calibration split only after train selection is frozen
calibration.operating_threshold: 80th percentile calibrated risk using deterministic sorted index; test applies the scalar threshold unchanged

evaluation.scope: test once in Phase B; test answers are first materialized only after exclusive creation of TEST_EVALUATION_STARTED.json
metrics: 80% rank-based auto subset EM error rate
80% rank-based auto subset mean ANLS and mean 1-ANLS
calibration-threshold test coverage and the same selective metrics
evaluation.rank_tie_break: ascending risk then question_id for auto-processing; descending risk then question_id for review
evaluation.aurc_discrete_definition: For n test items sorted from lowest to highest predicted risk, AURC = (1/n) * sum over k=1..n of the mean endpoint error among the first k items; no trapezoidal interpolation is used.

bootstrap.paired_difference: combined minus confidence-only on identical resampled documents
bootstrap.interval_reporting: every interval records requested_replicates and valid_replicates; undefined replicates are counted, not silently hidden

test_markers.started: Within this Phase B invocation, exclusive-create immediately before the first test ground-truth materialization; before this marker, source bytes may be hashed and top-level JSON syntax lexically scanned, but the Phase B pipeline does not decode or materialize a test answer value and does not compute a derived test endpoint label
test_markers.completed: exclusive-create after test metrics are written
test_markers.retry_policy: STARTED without COMPLETED blocks automatic retry

source_transaction.manifest_entry_policy: exactly the 13 approved source/spec/test paths; missing and extra entries fail
source_transaction.staging_policy: same-parent staging directory on the final output volume
source_transaction.commit_policy: supported Windows runner uses atomic non-overwrite os.rename; an existing or concurrently created final destination fails
source_transaction.post_marker_failure: preserve staging and STARTED; automatic retry forbidden
